primaries.name: multi_period_replenishment_milp
primaries.discriminator: Instruction describes multi-period inventory replenishment with cold storage capacity, per-SKU cold_usage, and ordering decisions over a horizon at one or more DCs/warehouses
primaries.algorithm_skeleton: Build a MILP/CP-SAT model over (period, SKU, location) with integer order variables. Precompute effective unit costs (purchase + holding + shortage + surcharges). Simulate inventory state period-by-period: inv[t] = inv[t-1] + arrivals[t] - sales[t] - spoilage[t]. Enforce cold capacity weighted by cold_usage at BOTH peak (post-arrival) and end-of-period. Minimize total cost (purchase + holding + shortage + spoilage). Emit dense output grid over all (period, SKU, location).
core_constraints: Order quantity variables must be declared as Integer (not Continuous)
Cold capacity constraint must be weighted by per-SKU cold_usage at every storage location
Cold capacity must be enforced at PEAK occupancy (prev_inv + arrivals) AND end-of-period, not just end-of-period
Inventory non-negativity enforced at every period (no netting across periods)
Output CSV must contain a complete dense grid over all (period × SKU × location) including zero-order rows
Output column names must exactly match spec (e.g., 'order_units' not 'order_qty'); integer cast before write

primaries.name: multi_supplier_procurement_milp
primaries.discriminator: Instruction describes selecting among multiple suppliers with conditional cost modifiers (discounts, surcharges, risk premiums, MOQs) over a planning horizon, without cold storage as a primary bottleneck
primaries.algorithm_skeleton: Precompute fully-loaded effective unit cost cost[supplier, product, month] folding in price, lead-time surcharge, risk premium, and FX. Build MILP with integer purchase quantities x[s,p,m], binary supplier-used y[s], binary month-active b[s,m], binary discount-taken ep[s,m]. Linearize binary×continuous terms (e.g. discount × qty) via auxiliary variables with big-M. Minimize Σ effective_cost · x − discount_savings, subject to demand satisfaction, supplier capacity, and any portfolio rules.
core_constraints: Purchase quantities declared as Integer variables
All discrete decisions (supplier-used, discount-taken) modeled as explicit binaries
Bilinear terms (binary × continuous) linearized via auxiliary variables with big-M tied to capacity
Effective unit cost precomputed outside solver, including lead-time surcharge and risk premium
Output CSV uses exact required column names with complete row coverage

extension_recipes.supplier_weekly_capacity: Add per-week supplier capacity constraint: Σ_p order[p,t] ≤ supplier_capacity[t]. Allow pre-ordering by enabling order in earlier weeks, but constrain cold capacity to absorb the pre-built inventory at peak occupancy.
extension_recipes.pre_build_lookahead: When capacity is tight near peak demand weeks, augment the model to look ahead: include forward demand in the planning horizon so the solver can pre-build. If using greedy fallback, add buffer = min(future_demand * 0.2, cap_slack).
extension_recipes.early_payment_discount: Add binary ep[s,m] indicating early-payment for supplier s in month m. Introduce auxiliary z[s,m] = ep[s,m] · qty[s,m] with big-M linearization (z ≤ M·ep, z ≤ qty, z ≥ qty − M·(1−ep), z ≥ 0). Subtract 0.01 · price · z from objective.
extension_recipes.lead_time_surcharge: During effective-cost precomputation, add $5/unit to suppliers with lead_time > 7 days: eff_cost[s,p,m] += 5 if lead_time[s] > 7.
extension_recipes.hub_spoke_transshipment: Add a hub location with its own inventory state. Decision variables: order[hub, t] from supplier, transfer[hub→spoke, p, t] with per-transfer cost. Spoke inventory only flows from hub transfers. Apply weighted cold capacity at hub AND each spoke independently.
extension_recipes.quality_substitution: Allow premium SKU to satisfy standard SKU demand when standard is short: add variable sub[premium→standard, t, loc] in the demand-fulfillment equation: sales_std + sub ≥ demand_std (capped by available premium inventory). Decrement premium inventory by sub.
extension_recipes.weighted_cold_capacity_at_all_nodes: Apply Σ_p inv[p,t,loc] · cold_usage[p] ≤ cold_capacity[loc] at EVERY location (hub and all spokes), not only the hub. Enforce both at peak (post-arrival/post-transfer-in) and end-of-period.
extension_recipes.lead_time_arrivals: Define arrivals[p,t,loc] = order[p, t − lead_time[loc], loc] (zero if t < lead_time). Inventory update uses arrivals not orders. Emit order rows for ALL periods 1..T even when t + lead_time > T (zero is acceptable but row must exist).
